review_items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact c52895a53e47457d84e514dbfc529729 v1, its retained harness and plan, claim/bindings v1, and raw execution 90b52d071c5c4272b13d717b4bfd1160. The obligation applies because JointImplicit explicitly makes Raft propose the zero change and AutoLeave promises final configuration when safe; JointExplicit separately requires a caller proposal. The general dropped-client-proposal retry clause does not make an unrelated new command a required continuation for this internal exit.

History and caller duties: all three RawNodes are created with actual MemoryStorage and Bootstrap peers 1,2,3; Ready processing persists entries and HardState before any network delivery, applies configuration entries in order, and calls Advance. Campaign is exercised normally and the initial term-2 no-op is fully applied before the implicit removal of voter 3. The joint entry is generated, replicated and committed at index 5. The hook invokes public TransferLeader(2) after ApplyConfChange of that entry and before Advance of the same Ready; these are serialized public operations and no contract excludes that overlap. This is after Ready internally called acceptReady, so its prohibition on intervening mutation between readyWithoutAccept and acceptReady is respected. The normal implementation generates TimeoutNow and the network policy drops exactly one such message during the initial drain. It never drops a local durability/application response; the loss policy is then disabled. All subsequent node ticks, queued messages and Ready work are serviced. Normal no-op entries need no state-machine data effect; the membership-changing entries are actually applied. No call substitutes a fabricated vote, append reply, committed index or completion.

Observed correlation: overlap=true is a preselected input; control overlap=false is excluded before matching prerequisites. The operation label is independent of the compared state. There is one matching admitted operation, its change index and term are bound to the settled prerequisite, and one independent continuation_result. Raw logs show admission at committed index 5 with AutoLeave=true and transferee=2; settlement shows applied=committed=last=5, same leader and term 2, transferee=0, one lost TimeoutNow and no queue/Ready work. The monitor recorded matched prerequisites and no parsing errors. Control events share the operation label but cannot match the overlap=true prerequisite conditions; no result is selected from that control.

Oracle and recurrence: the assertion requires forbidden_cycle=false. Its observed true value is a conjunction computed from actual target state and the executed schedule, not from the expected answer. I independently parsed the retained raw cycle_start and cycle_end strings: both 18,121-character structural snapshots are equal. They include every reflected RawNode, raft, log, unstable, MemoryStorage, tracker, per-peer inflight/buffer, read queue, stored response, timer and function identity field, including unexported fields, slice nilness/capacity and the transport queue. All three nodes have committed=applied=applying=5, zero applying bytes and no paused application. All outgoing/deferred message slices and stepsOnAdvance are empty. Leader electionElapsed and heartbeatElapsed are zero at both ends; followers' election timers are also zero, with captured randomized deadlines 16,16,12 for nodes 1,2,3. The cycle delivered 20 MsgHeartbeat and 20 MsgHeartbeatResp, no other type, retained joint state throughout, and reached a drained boundary.

Closure and observation ownership: one test goroutine performs all target calls and sampling; no Node run goroutine, storage worker, pending Ready or application callback exists. The fixed input schedule ticks nodes 1,2,3 then drains the FIFO until quiescence, repeated ten times. Those same inputs can be repeated from the equal state. Driver counters and output timestamps do not influence protocol inputs. Snapshot omissions are specifically the logger sinks and MemoryStorage.callStats. Reading the storage methods and all callStats uses establishes increment-only diagnostic accounting; default logger writes diagnostics, and the build assertion plus state_trace_nop establishes no active tracing callback. Logger state and crypto randomness cannot supply a missing continuation: heartbeat handling resets follower election timers, the active leader satisfies quorum checks, no election/role-reset path runs in this suffix, and random draws occur only in resetRandomizedElectionTimeout. Captured function code identities are sufficient here because tick/step receiver objects are the same instances and their data is included; no closure replacement happens. Thus this is a repeatable reliable execution with available quorums, not a deadline inferred from thirty ticks.

Causal account and contrary evidence: appliedTo tries the automatic proposal while leadTransferee is set; stepLeader rejects proposals during transfer. tickHeartbeat aborts transfer but abortLeaderTransfer only clears the field. Subsequent heartbeat-only Ready batches contain no committed entries, so acceptReady queues no MsgStorageApplyResp and Advance never calls appliedTo again. This explains the missing continuation. The fixed control left joint at index 6. The later ordinary-proposal diagnostic caused application and exit at index 7. Both are retained and show that application or a future leader/no-op can rescue progress; neither is a caller duty needed to finalize an already-applied implicit transition. This review supports the scoped implementation discrepancy, not a broader safety or deployment availability conclusion.
limitations: One synchronous RawNode transfer-overlap history; asynchronous storage and other configuration histories are not tested.
The repeated-cycle argument abstracts diagnostic counters and logger state only; it assumes continuing memory/storage availability and the selected reliable input schedule.
No numerical deadline, state-machine safety failure, external client outage or whole-deployment consequence is established.
review_items.report_title: 领导权转移超时后，自动退出联合配置丢失后续触发
review_items.report_answer: 隐式联合配置在索引 5 应用时与领导权转移重叠，转移超时后仍停留在联合状态。正式执行记录了处理 20 次心跳及 20 次回复后协议状态完全重复、无待处理工作；追加普通提案才触发退出。该结果限定于自动配置收尾的进展责任，不表示共识安全性被破坏。

feedback.answered: The fixed execution reached the public-API overlap and measured a closed heartbeat-only cycle after transfer timeout: all three nodes stayed joint with full application through index 5; captured protocol states, queues and timers repeat. Source review connects the lost internal proposal to the absence of application responses in message-only Advance calls. Checker correspondence found no issue for this scoped witness, retaining the successful control and rescue observations.
remaining: Carry the sourced conditional continuation relationship into the next related map update; broader configuration and authority questions remain independent.
feedback.rationale: The formal result is supported by the executed recurrence and reviewed state closure, not by Go test success or the earlier finite exploration. No deadline was invented.

rationale: Review exact fixed inputs, reached history, independent admission, raw state recurrence, caller duties and alternative continuations together. No issue found in correspondence for the scoped automatic-finalization counterexample.
